text:
Hello everyone,

I'm an Israeli living in Amsterdam with my wife (half Dutch, half Iranian) and our 4-month-old baby. We want to visit family and friends in Israel, but under the new ETA-IL system my wife's application keeps getting refused (for a tourist visa). This is despite her having received a B1 visa in 2020, and the two of us living in Israel together for a year. 

The embassy in The Hague hasn't been able to help. 

In September (2026) we only got in after I called everyone I know, and the approval came through at the last minute. We now plan to go for a week and a half to Israel this December (bought tickets long time ago), and no one can tell me what my wife's visa status is now.

Since I don't live in Israel, my mother keeps going to Misrad HaPnim to submit the same documents again and again, and no one can say when we'll get an answer.

All I'm trying to find out is:

1. Since she entered in September, does my wife now have a valid ETA for two years, or was it a one-time approval?

2. How do I make sure that every family visit doesn't turn into an exhausting, humiliating fight with bureaucracy?

I'd really appreciate any help or advice. Thank you!
